claim: The catch block counts every thrown error (transient Twilio 5xx/network errors, the smsMonth rate-limit throw, missing Twilio env) as a retry, so with the */15 cron a reminder scheduled days ahead is permanently deleted after ~30 minutes of any transient failure.

scheduleSMS returns undefined when the user/team is SMS-locked, so the new else-branch increments retryCount and the reminders of locked (e.g. under review) accounts are deleted after two runs instead of being kept until unlocked.
The new retryCount branch of deleteMany has no method filter, so the SMS cron deletes Email/WhatsApp reminders with retryCount > 1 as soon as any other code path starts using the shared column.
body:
## [ISSUE] `retryCount` delete branch is not scoped to `WorkflowMethods.SMS`

**Severity:** MEDIUM — the SMS cron can delete Email and WhatsApp reminders it does not own.

### The Problem

```ts
OR: [
  { method: WorkflowMethods.SMS, scheduledDate: { lte: ... } },
  { retryCount: { gt: 1 } },   // no method filter
],
```

The first branch is scoped to SMS, the second is not. `retryCount` was added to the shared `WorkflowReminder` model (`packages/prisma/schema.prisma`), which also stores `EMAIL` and `WHATSAPP` reminders handled by `scheduleEmailReminders.ts` and `scheduleWhatsappReminders.ts`.

### What happens today vs. what will break

Today only this file increments `retryCount`, and only for SMS rows, so nothing else is deleted. The obvious next step is to add the same retry logic to `scheduleWhatsappReminders.ts` (which still has the identical "retry until date" behaviour, lines 23-30) or to email reminders, possibly with a different threshold. At that point the SMS cron, running every 15 minutes, will delete WhatsApp/email reminders based on the SMS threshold, before their own cron gets to decide.

### Recommendation

Scope the whole where clause to SMS:

```ts
await prisma.workflowReminder.deleteMany({
  where: {
    method: WorkflowMethods.SMS,
    OR: [
      { scheduledDate: { lte: dayjs().toISOString() } },
      { retryCount: { gt: 1 } },
    ],
  },
});
```

claim: When sendTo is missing or the message is empty the reminder is skipped without incrementing retryCount, so these permanently unschedulable reminders are still retried every 15 minutes until their date, which is what the PR set out to stop.

The prisma update inside the catch block is unguarded; if it throws (e.g. the reminder was deleted by a concurrent booking cancellation, or the original error was a DB error) the exception escapes the loop and the remaining reminders in the batch are not processed.
